title: The Ahrefs and SEMrush Filter Method
subtitle: Skip the site, go straight at the keyword layer

sections.heading: Three filter sets taught for this method

items.title: Starter filters
points: Lowest DR: 20, in top 10 or top 5

items.title: Second filter set
points: At most 2 EMDs, none with RD above 60

items.title: Revision pass
points: SERP features: exclude AI Overview or video-heavy

columns.title: One keyword, many niches
items: {FAB}: balance check for every bank in a city
{BANK}: salary check for every bank in a city
{Company}: tracker for every company in a city

columns.title: A worked example
items: At least 3 SERP sites with DA under 20

sections.quote: 10,000 searches in the USA is not 100,000 in Pakistan.
sections.text: Tier 1 traffic is worth more per visit, so country changes what a good volume is.
